'''Alderaanian walking barnacles''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="Rots" /> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Rots" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the sight of the eerily life-like ripples of Separatist [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] clinging to the curves of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] resembled the bristling of Alderaanian walking [[Barnacle/Legends|barnacles]] on a marine predator.<ref name="Rots" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alderaanian walking barnacles were mentioned in [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[2005]] [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Rots" />
